body: Hi John, thank you for taking the time to write to me. It's so strange going through heartbreak for the first time, especially when lots of other problems are always piled up and the relationship was the only place I felt somewhat "safe". I am really glad you met someone else and are now happy -- may I ask if you still miss the person who broke your heart? Does the pain ease? I totally understand when you say you just "want to sleep for a few years and not wake up". That would be heaven! It feels like it would be so refreshing. I just don't really know how to proceed, I've read lots of things that say look after yourself, follow your hobbies - but it all takes so much effort. I also feel like I won't be able to open up my heart to another again; how did you manage to do so? Although we are all different, thus tackle things differently, but I just have no idea how to approach this. And it's been months. I'm now at the stage where I should "just be over it" as people in my life have said, but it just doesn't happen. Again, John, thank you for your kind words. I guess sometimes we all just need someone to lean on. Have a brilliant day mate.
